# Bundled libraries

`katex.min.js` is [KaTeX](https://katex.org) 0.16.22, copied unchanged from
`dist/katex.min.js` in the npm package `katex@0.16.22` (SHA-1
`d2b3d66464b1e6d69e6463b28a86ced5a02c5ccd`). It is licensed under the MIT
license in `KATEX-LICENSE`.

KíLín uses it only to draw LaTeX maths in answers as MathML, so no KaTeX
fonts or stylesheet are needed. It ships with the GUI, so nothing is
downloaded when the app runs.
